# Pilotest

> > Comprehensive pilot selection test preparation platform specializing in psychotechnical assessments for airline recruitment across Europe.

Pilotest provides targeted training resources for aspiring pilots preparing for selection tests from major airlines and aviation academies. The platform covers standardized assessment systems used by Air France, ENAC-EPL, EasyJet, Lufthansa, and other European carriers, helping candidates master cognitive aptitude, psychotechnical, and psychomotor evaluations.

## Key Topics

- Pilot selection tests
- Psychotechnical assessment
- Airline recruitment
- Air France (Cadets & Professional)
- ENAC-EPL exams
- CUT-E online tests
- COMPASS screening
- PILAPT® preparation
- DLR BU/GU tests
- Cognitive aptitude training
- Test preparation
- Pilot training
- EasyJet & Aer Lingus selection
- Psychomotor evaluation
- Airline pilot recruitment

## Getting Started

- [Pilotest Homepage](https://www.pilotest.com): Main homepage for Pilotest pilot selection test preparation platform
- [Pilotest - Version Française](https://www.pilotest.com/fr): French homepage for Pilotest pilot selection test preparation platform
- [Sign Up for Pilotest](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/users/sign_up): User registration and account creation page for Pilotest

## Air France Pilot Selection

- [Air France Cadet PSY0 Test Preparation](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/preparez-la-preselection-pilotes-cadets-air-france): Air France cadet psy0 test preparation guide and training resources
- [Air France Cadet PSY1 Test Preparation](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/preparez-les-tests-psychotechniques-et-psychomoteurs-des-selections-pilotes-cadets-air-france): Air France cadet psy1 psychotechnical test preparation guide
- [Air France Professional Pilot PSY1 Tests](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/preparez-les-tests-psychotechniques-et-psychomoteurs-des-selections-pilote-air-france): Air France/HOP professional pilot psy1 test preparation guide

## Aviation Academy & Major Airline Selection

- [ENAC-EPL Psychotechnical & Psychomotor Tests](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/preparez-les-tests-psychotechniques-et-psychomoteurs-du-concours-enac-epl): ENAC-EPL psychotechnical and psychomotor test preparation guide
- [CUT-E Online Test Preparation](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/preparation-tests-en-ligne-CUT-E): CUT-E online test preparation for EasyJet, Aer Lingus, L3 recruitment
- [DLR BU/GU Test Preparation](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/tests-DLR-bu-gu-entrainement-selection-pilotes): DLR BU/GU test preparation for Lufthansa, Swiss, Cargolux recruitment

## Standardized Assessment Systems

- [COMPASS Pilot Aptitude Screening](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/entrainement-tests-pilot-compass): COMPASS pilot aptitude screening system test preparation guide
- [PILAPT® Psychotechnical Tests](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/selections/preparez-les-tests-psychotechniques-du-pilapt): PILAPT psychotechnical test preparation for airline pilot recruitment

## Optional Resources

- [Miscellaneous Pilot Tests](https://www.pilotest.com/fr/lonely_tests): Miscellaneous pilot psychotechnical tests and training exercises
